title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: PGA Tour Schedule Change
items.text: Starting in 2028, PGA Tour's top-130 players in the Championship Series cannot play in Challenger Series events, aiming to keep stars in Tier 1 fields with $20 million purses.

items.headline: LIV Golf's Future Doubtful
items.text: Carlos Ortiz says LIV Golf's outlook post-2026 is "not looking great" due to Saudi PIF funding ending, with CEO Scott O’Neil seeking $250–$300 million from outside investors.

items.headline: Koepka Withdraws from Scottish Open
items.text: Brooks Koepka withdrew from the $9M Genesis Scottish Open over a hand/arm tingling issue that may affect his grip ahead of the Open Championship next week.
